nodes.label: PANSS Thirty-Item Instrument
nodes.rationale: Positive, negative and general subscales rated over the previous 7 days capture severity without establishing diagnosis or treatment on their own.

nodes.label: PANSS Subscale Sum Scoring
nodes.rationale: Unreversed 1-7 item sums (positive 7-49, negative 7-49, general 16-112, total 30-210) keep anchors approximate so totals never become treatment thresholds.
